settings.heading: A small team that does the whole job.
settings.subcopy: socal labs is a digital product and growth studio in Los Angeles. We design, build and then grow, because the gap between those three is where most projects die.

settings.heading: Why brands hire one team instead of five vendors
settings.subcopy: The handoff tax is real, and expensive.

settings.pain: I have five vendors and nobody owns the number.
settings.answer: One team across build, creative and growth. One report, one person accountable for the outcome.

settings.pain: Dev ships, then marketing invents a different story.
settings.answer: The people who build the product run the campaigns pointed at it, same brief, same metric.

settings.pain: Creative waits three weeks for a revision.
settings.answer: In-house creative next to media and product, test sets weekly, not quarterly.

settings.pain: Account managers translate; makers never hear me.
settings.answer: You talk to the people doing the work. No relay.
